name: w3b_slot_thrash_interleaved
description: Three agents with different 500-token system prompts running concurrently. With small start-delay offsets the agents land in approximate round-robin, so each turn arrives when another agent's state is in the single live slot. Metric: TTFT per turn. With OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL < 3 each turn should cost a full re-prefill (nothing to resume from the prompt cache that still matches the active agent's prefix) and TTFT at every turn stays near the cold-cache cost of a 500+48 prompt. With NUM_PARALLEL >= 3 every agent gets its own slot and TTFT drops back to the w3a numbers. Sweep OLLAMA_NUM_PARALLEL 1 / 2 / 4.
